# Change order CO-03: Larkspur Ceramics

## What changes
Each Monday at 8:00 the operations manager gets a text message with the number of orders on the exceptions list.

## Why
In acceptance testing your operations manager asked for a weekly text message about the exceptions list (UAT-07). No system in the agreed scope sends text messages, so this is new work.

## Price
USD 450.00, invoiced when the amendment is signed, due within 14 days of the invoice.

## Schedule
No change to the acceptance testing dates, if this is signed by 25 January 2027.

## Acceptance checks it adds
### AC-CO-03.1
- when: it is Monday at 8:00
- then: the operations manager's phone gets one text message giving the number of orders on the exceptions list
- how we check: on 2 Mondays, compare the message with the exceptions list as it stood at 8:00
- test data: the exceptions list on 2 Mondays of acceptance testing
- cases: 2
- kind: normal

### AC-CO-03.2
- when: the exceptions list is empty on a Monday
- then: the message says there are no orders on the list
- how we check: empty the list for the test and wait for the Monday message
- test data: 1 Monday with the list emptied for the test
- cases: 1
- kind: error

## Approval
This change order is approved only by a signed amendment to our contract. A reply to this email is not approval, and no work starts before the amendment is signed.
